Question B-007-005-005.

Why the correct answer is right: Beyond ground wave and ordinary line of sight, radio communication depends strongly on ionization and atmospheric conditions driven by solar radiation.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "The F2 region of the ionosphere": The F2 region of the ionosphere is very important for HF DX, but the broader influence on all beyond-local paths is solar radiation.
- sourceIndex 2: "The F1 region of the ionosphere": The F1 region of the ionosphere is only one sub-region and cannot explain all beyond-ground-wave or beyond-line-of-sight communication.
- sourceIndex 3: "Lunar tidal effects": Lunar tidal effects are not the main driver of these radio propagation conditions.
